claim: source unit creation: IngestionManagementService.create_source_unit stores a SourceUnit from raw_content of SourceUnitCreateInput
source unit creation: SourceUnitCreateInput also gives source_type, title, optional sequence_no, external_ref, metadata_json
source unit initial status: IngestionManagementService.create_source_unit stores the SourceUnit with status READY
source unit creation: create_source_unit requires an existing project and a non-DRAFT schema version of that project
source unit creation: without an existing project and non-DRAFT schema version, NotFoundError or RuleViolationError is raised
segmentation: is a separate call, PipelineManagementService.generate_segments
segmentation strategy: the only accepted strategy of generate_segments is paragraphs; anything else raises RuleViolationError
segmentation split rule: _split_into_segments splits raw content on blank lines (\n\s*\n)
segmentation fallback: with at most one chunk _split_into_segments falls back to non-empty lines, then whole stripped content
segment fields: each Segment gets a new UUID, a 1-based segment_order and metadata_json={"strategy": "paragraphs"}
segment offsets: a Segment has no offsets into raw_content
segment size limit: no size limit or overlap is applied to a Segment
segment regeneration: replace_for_source_unit deletes the source unit's existing segments first
segment regeneration: regenerating segments changes every segment_id
extraction without segments: raises "Segments must be generated before candidate extraction can run."
LLM provider registration: get_container always registers NoOpLLMProvider (noop)
LLM provider registration: get_container adds OpenAILLMProvider (openai) only when openai_api_key is non-blank
default LLM provider: the default provider is noop, which always returns empty nodes and relations
LLM provider selection: _require_llm_provider uses the run's llm_provider, else the default provider
LLM provider selection: an unregistered provider name raises RuleViolationError in _require_llm_provider
LLM model selection: the model is the run's llm_model, else default_llm_model
LLM model selection: OpenAI raises RuleViolationError without a model
extraction prompt key: the prompt is fetched by key candidate_graph_extraction and version default_extraction_prompt_version
default prompt version: default_extraction_prompt_version is candidate_graph_extraction_v1
extraction prompt version: an unregistered prompt version raises RuleViolationError
extraction prompt node fields: asks for nodes with ref, node_type, properties, merge_key_payload, confidence, evidence_refs
extraction prompt relation fields: asks for relations with relation_type, from_ref, to_ref, properties, confidence, evidence_refs
extraction LLM calls: extract_candidates makes one generate_structured call
extraction prompt payload: _build_prompt_payload sends run ids, source-unit metadata and all segments
extraction prompt payload: _build_prompt_payload does not send the source unit's raw_content
extraction prompt payload: sends every node and relation type with merge keys, thresholds, aliases, hints, property definitions
OpenAI request URL: OpenAILLMProvider POSTs to {base_url}/chat/completions
OpenAI request parameters: OpenAILLMProvider sends temperature: 0 and response_format json_object
OpenAI request messages: prompt is the system message, {"schema_name", "payload"} JSON is the user message
extraction dry_run: with dry_run no candidate is persisted
extraction precondition: without dry_run the run must have no candidates yet
extraction execution record: each extraction call writes an ExtractionExecution record (RUNNING, then SUCCEEDED or FAILED)
LLM output content: _extract_content accepts string content or a list of text parts
LLM output parsing: _parse_output strips a surrounding ``` fence and runs json.loads
LLM output errors: missing choices, non-text content or non-JSON output raise ExternalServiceError
extraction output validation: _normalize_output validates the output against StructuredExtractionContract
extraction output unknown fields: StructuredExtractionContract has extra="ignore", which drops unknown fields
extraction output confidence: StructuredExtractionContract requires confidence to be 0–1
extraction output validation: a StructuredExtractionContract mismatch raises RuleViolationError in _normalize_output
type name resolution: _resolve_node_type and _resolve_relation_type use a stripped, casefolded registry of names and aliases
type alias resolution: an alias is replaced by the canonical type name
ambiguous type lookup: a lookup shared by two types raises "Schema contains ambiguous … lookup"
undefined type in extraction: an undefined node or relation type raises RuleViolationError
undefined type error message: "Structured extraction returned undefined node type '…'"
undefined type in extraction: the item with an undefined type is neither skipped nor sent to review
extraction fatal errors: a duplicate node ref is fatal
extraction fatal errors: a relation referencing an unknown ref is fatal
extraction fatal errors: a relation whose endpoint node types differ from from_type or to_type is fatal
extracted properties: candidate properties are copied as returned
undefined properties in extraction: property names the schema does not define are kept
extracted property types: property values are not type-checked
merge_key_payload in extraction: merge_key_payload is rebuilt by derive_merge_key_payload
extraction failure: any exception aborts the execution and no candidate is created
extraction failure: the execution is saved FAILED with error_message
extraction failure: run and source unit become FAILED
extraction failure retry: the exception is re-raised without retry
extraction success: each suggestion becomes a CandidateNode or CandidateRelation with status PENDING
validation entry point: validate_run is also called by resolve_duplicates
validation of completed runs: validate_run rejects COMPLETED runs
validation rerun: validate_run re-evaluates every candidate
validation rerun: validate_run replaces all ValidationResult rows and all review items of the run, decided ones included
ValidationResult fields: candidate_ref, rule_code, severity, result and message
ValidationResult severity values: error, warning, info
ValidationResult result values: failed, review, passed
node validation errors: set REJECTED; rule codes node_type_exists, required_node_property, node_merge_key
node_type_exists rule: lookup by casefolded name, aliases not consulted
node confidence threshold: confidence strictly below the type's confidence_threshold gives REVIEW with node_confidence_threshold
node validated status: a node with no error and confidence not below the threshold gets VALIDATED with candidate_node_valid
relation validation errors: set REJECTED; relation_type_exists, relation_candidate_refs, relation_from_type, relation_to_type
relation validation errors: set REJECTED; required_relation_property, relation_dependency_rejected
required_relation_property rule: covers the union of required_properties and properties flagged required
relation review status: a relation becomes REVIEW when an endpoint node is in REVIEW (relation_dependency_review)
relation confidence threshold: confidence below the type threshold gives REVIEW (relation_confidence_threshold)
relation validated status: a relation with no error or review condition gets VALIDATED with candidate_relation_valid
candidate status COMMITTED: CandidateStatus also defines COMMITTED, but no code assigns COMMITTED
EvidenceRef fields: an EvidenceRef holds segment_id plus optional quote, start_offset, end_offset
evidence segment check in extraction: _build_evidence_ref requires each segment_id to belong to the run's source unit
evidence segment check in extraction: a segment_id outside the source unit raises RuleViolationError, failing the whole extraction
evidence check for API-added candidates: _ensure_evidence_refs_belong_to_source_unit applies the segment_id source-unit rule
evidence quote check: there is no check that quote occurs in the segment text
evidence offset check: there is no check that offsets fit the segment text; offsets only have to be non-negative
evidence requirement: there is no rule requiring evidence; evidence_refs defaults to empty
evidence requirement: _validate_candidate_node reaches VALIDATED without reading evidence_refs
node evidence on commit: each ref becomes (n)-[:SUPPORTED_BY {run_id, candidate_ref, segment_id}]->(sg:Segment)
node evidence on commit: evidence refs to segments outside the bundle are skipped
evidence in Neo4j: quote and offsets of an evidence ref are not written to Neo4j
relation evidence on commit: goes to a RelationEvidence node keyed by candidate_relation_id
relation evidence on commit: RelationEvidence node is linked by FROM_NODE, TO_NODE, DERIVED_FROM and SUPPORTED_BY
review queue evidence snippets: _build_evidence_snippets returns the segment's order and text with the stored quote
merge key payload: derive_merge_key_payload keeps only the node type's merge_keys
merge key payload: derive_merge_key_payload reads each merge key from properties, else from the supplied payload
text normalisation: normalize_text applies NFKC, strip, whitespace collapse and casefold
payload key: normalized_payload_key serialises the normalised payload as key-sorted compact JSON
candidate node key: build_candidate_node_resolution_key is <normalised node_type>::<normalised merge_key_payload>
candidate node duplicate matching: exact string equality of the key, with no fuzzy or similarity comparison
duplicate node detection: _flag_duplicate_candidate_nodes groups non-rejected nodes with a non-empty payload by node key
duplicate node detection: the highest-confidence group member (ties by candidate_node_id) keeps its status
duplicate node detection: the other members of a duplicate group become REVIEW with potential_duplicate_node
candidate relation key: joins the normalised relation_type, both endpoint identity keys and the normalised properties
candidate relation key endpoint identity: candidate_node_identity_key, or candidate::<id>
duplicate relation detection: duplicate relations become REVIEW with potential_duplicate_relation
canonical identity: build_canonical_merge_key is the SHA-256 hex of the normalised merge-key payload
canonical identity with empty payload: build_canonical_merge_key hashes {"candidate_node_id": …} instead
node without merge keys: never merges with another node
canonical match annotation: _annotate_canonical_matches looks up existing canonical nodes and relations
canonical match annotation: adds info results canonical_node_match or canonical_relation_match; statuses are unchanged
review duplicate node: _ensure_candidate_node_unique_within_run raises RuleViolationError for a same-key non-rejected pair
review duplicate relation: _ensure_candidate_relation_unique_within_run raises RuleViolationError for a same-key non-rejected pair
review uniqueness check: applies when a review decision would leave two non-rejected candidates with the same key
review item creation: _build_review_items creates one ReviewItem per candidate in REVIEW
ReviewItem fields set by _build_review_items: item_type, item_ref, reason_code and payload_json
ReviewItem item_type values: candidate_node or candidate_relation
ReviewItem reason_code: first rule code with result review, else candidate_review
ReviewItem payload_json: holds type, confidence, messages
ReviewItem fields: a ReviewItem also holds status, reviewer_note and created_at
ReviewItem status values: open, accepted, rejected, edited
reviewer identity: a ReviewItem has no reviewer identity and no decision timestamp
review decision actions: decide_review_item accepts accept, reject or edit
review decision errors: in decide_review_item a non-open item raises ConflictError, any other action RuleViolationError
review decision reject: reject sets the candidate REJECTED
review decision accept and edit: accept and edit set the candidate VALIDATED
review edit of a node: edit can change a node's node_type, properties, merge_key_payload, confidence
review edit of a relation: edit can change a relation's relation_type, endpoints, properties, confidence
review node checks: a non-rejected node needs a defined type, required properties and merge keys (_validate_candidate_node_state)
review node type change: _ensure_node_relations_remain_compatible blocks a type change that breaks a non-rejected relation
review node checks: the confidence threshold is not re-checked for a non-rejected node in review
review relation checks: a non-rejected relation requires a defined type and both endpoint nodes VALIDATED in the same run
review relation checks: a non-rejected relation requires matching endpoint types and required properties
review refresh: after every decision _refresh_relation_reviews_for_run re-evaluates all relations of the run
review refresh: open relation review items are updated, created, or closed with a note
review auto-close notes: "Auto-resolved after dependent review decision." or "Auto-closed after dependent review decision."
review refresh threshold: _refresh_relation_reviews_for_run re-evaluation applies relation_confidence_threshold again
relation accepted while still below the threshold: returns to REVIEW with a new open item after the review re-evaluation
commit precondition: commit_run raises ConflictError if the run already has a graph delta
commit precondition: commit_run raises RuleViolationError if any candidate is PENDING or any review item is OPEN
commit precondition: commit_run raises RuleViolationError if a validated relation points to a non-validated node
commit bundle contents: only VALIDATED candidates enter the CanonicalCommitBundle
commit delta counts: rejected candidates are counted in GraphDelta.rejected_count
commit delta counts: the graph delta's review_count is always 0
repository backend: repository_backend == "postgres" uses Postgres repositories for metadata
repository backend: repository_backend == "postgres" uses Neo4jCanonicalGraphRepository for the graph
repository backend: any other repository_backend value uses in-memory repositories for everything
commit transactions: commit_bundle issues a separate session.execute_write for the source context and for the delta
commit transactions: commit_bundle issues a separate session.execute_write for each node merge and each node provenance link
commit transactions: commit_bundle issues a separate session.execute_write per relation merge and per relation provenance link
commit transactions: the commit_bundle commit is not one transaction
commit rollback: nothing undoes completed commit_bundle writes when a later write fails
commit source context: MERGE (su:SourceUnit {source_unit_id}) and MERGE (sg:Segment {segment_id})
commit source context: links (su)-[:HAS_SEGMENT]->(sg)
commit node MERGE key: MERGE (n:CanonicalNode:<node_type> {project_id, node_type, merge_key})
commit node properties: after the MERGE, SET n += $properties, source_unit_id, last_run_id, updated_at
commit node properties: None values are dropped; nested lists and dicts are JSON-encoded
commit node type name: a type name outside ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ raises ValueError
commit relation MERGE key: MERGE (from)-[r:<relation_type> {project_id, relation_type}]->(to)
commit relation properties: after the MERGE, SET r += $properties
commit relation identity: relation properties are not part of relationship identity
commit success: graph_delta_repository.add stores the delta and the run becomes COMPLETED (source unit PROCESSED)
commit failure: on an exception run and source unit are saved FAILED and the error is re-raised
commit status writes: delta and status saves are separate repository calls outside the Neo4j transactions
SchemaVersion: belongs to a project and has a unique version_no; a duplicate version_no raises ConflictError
SchemaVersion initial status: a SchemaVersion starts DRAFT
SchemaVersion creation: also creates pipeline definition v1 from build_default_pipeline_steps
schema type editing: types can only be added to a DRAFT version ("Only draft schema versions can be edited.")
schema type editing: the service has no update or delete operation for types
schema activation: activate_schema_version sets the target ACTIVE from any status
schema activation: activate_schema_version turns any other ACTIVE version of the project into PUBLISHED
schema version status RETIRED: no code assigns RETIRED
NodeTypeDefinition fields: name, display_name, description, is_core, merge_keys, confidence_threshold, aliases
NodeTypeDefinition fields: extraction_hints, properties, is_active
NodeTypeDefinition name: unique per version, case-insensitive
NodeTypeDefinition confidence_threshold default: 0.5
RelationTypeDefinition fields: name, from_type, to_type, description, directional, aliases, extraction_hints
RelationTypeDefinition fields: required_properties, properties, confidence_threshold, is_active
RelationTypeDefinition from_type and to_type: both must already exist in the version, else RuleViolationError
RelationTypeDefinition confidence_threshold default: 0.7
PropertyDefinition fields: owner_kind, owner_type_name, name, data_type, required, description, default_value, enum_values
PropertyDefinition owner_kind values: node or relation
property validation: validation enforces only required and merge keys
property data_type check: data_type, enum_values and default_value reach the model but are never checked or applied
schema flags: is_core, directional, is_active do not affect extraction, validation or commit
templates: are the two SYSTEM_DOMAIN_TEMPLATES (blank, story) with id, name, slug and description
project template: create_project stores the resolved template_id (default blank)
project template: an unknown template_id raises RuleViolationError in create_project
project template: create_project creates no schema content from the template
processing run start: start_processing_run creates a ProcessingRun with status PENDING
processing run start: start_processing_run sets the source unit to PROCESSING
processing run start: start_processing_run rejects a DRAFT or already PROCESSING source unit
processing run start: start_processing_run rejects a schema version different from the source unit's
processing run start: start_processing_run rejects a pipeline_version without a pipeline definition
run status change: mark_run_started sets the run RUNNING
run status change: mark_run_failed sets the run FAILED and the source unit FAILED
run status change: mark_run_completed sets the run COMPLETED and the source unit PROCESSED
job enqueue: enqueue_job creates a ProcessingJob (pending) of type extract_candidates, validate_run or commit_run
job enqueue: enqueue_job rejects completed runs
job enqueue: enqueue_job raises ConflictError when the run already has a pending or running job of that type
job claim: Postgres claim_next takes the oldest PENDING job whose run has no RUNNING job and marks the job running
job claim locking: claim_next is guarded by pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(run_id)) and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
job processing: process_next_job executes the job, then enqueues the chain_on_success types from the job payload
job chaining: chain_on_success in the job payload is the request value, else the pipeline definition step
job chaining: process_next_job skips a chain_on_success type that is already active or has succeeded
job failure: any exception marks the job FAILED with error_message
job retry: only pending jobs are claimed, so failed jobs are not retried
job chaining and review: chaining ignores review items, so a chained commit_run fails while any review item is open
jobs worker: processing_jobs_worker.main loops over process_next_job, sleeping the poll interval when idle
jobs worker flags: --once, --job-type, --run-id, --poll-interval-seconds, --max-jobs
HTTP job routes: POST and GET /api/runs/{run_id}/processing-jobs
HTTP job routes: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/processing-jobs
HTTP job routes: POST /api/processing-jobs/process-next
HTTP error mapping: 404 NotFoundError, 409 ConflictError, 422 RuleViolationError, 502 ExternalServiceError
